# Third-party browser libraries

CoachTools vendors these browser distributions so normal local use does not depend on a CDN:

| Library | Version | Runtime file | License notice |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SheetJS Community Edition (`xlsx`) | 0.18.5 | `xlsx.full.min.js` | `licenses/xlsx-LICENSE.txt` |
| LZ-String | 1.5.0 | `lz-string.min.js` | `licenses/lz-string-LICENSE.txt` |
| Chart.js | 4.4.1 | `chart.umd.js` | `licenses/chart.js-LICENSE.md` |
| html2canvas | 1.4.1 | `html2canvas.min.js` | `licenses/html2canvas-LICENSE.txt` |
| jsPDF | 2.5.1 | `jspdf.umd.min.js` | `licenses/jspdf-LICENSE.txt` |
| html2pdf.js | 0.10.1 | `html2pdf.bundle.min.js` | `licenses/html2pdf.js-LICENSE.txt` |
| JSZip | 3.10.1 | `jszip.min.js` | `licenses/jszip-LICENSE.md` |

The copied license files are the authoritative notices for their respective packages.
